_Generated from `scripts/core/data.gd`, `scripts/match/life.gd`, `content/rules`, `content/combos`._

## Expedition tiers

| Tier | Monsters | Loot | Wild Boki levels | Unlocks after | Boki at risk | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The Meadow | x1 | x1 | 1 to 3 | 0 extractions | no | Gentle islands. Your Boki are always safe here: lose your loot, never your Boki. |
| Dusk Isles | x1.45 | x1.75 | 2 to 5 | 2 extractions | no | Tougher monsters, more loot, rarer Boki. Your Boki is always safe here: it goes home with you if you fall. |
| The Hollow | x2 | x2.75 | 4 to 8 | 5 extractions | dropped dazed, can be scanned | Brutal and rich. If you fall your Boki drops dazed beside your deathbox and guards it. Get revived and run into it to pick it up, or a rival can scan it and take it (knock it out, then hold the interact key). |

Trait drift (GARDEN.md section 3, lever 3; scripts/home/base_drift.gd): with farm_build.json base_mode on, once per in-game day at home each Boki's four traits (0..1) move a small step toward the average of its friends (base life bonds at or above base_life friend_at). Rivals do not pull.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| step | 0.03 |
| step_doc | share of the gap between a Boki's trait and its friends' average that closes each in-game day. |
| week_days | 7 |
| week_days_doc | in-game days in a drift week; the cap below resets when a Boki's week ends. |
| week_cap | 0.12 |
| week_cap_doc | most a single trait may move (either way, summed) in one drift week, in trait units (0..1). |
| bands | [0.33, 0.67] |
| bands_doc | trait values at which a trait changes band (low, middle, high); crossing one writes a journal line. |
| words | {"bravery": ["braver", "shyer"], "loyalty": ["more loyal", "more independent"], "temper": ["hotter-tempered", "calmer"], "curiosity": ["more curious", "more settled"]} |
| words_doc | per trait: [line when it rises, line when it falls], written as 'is getting <word>' in the Boki's journal. |

## base_echo (`content/rules/base_echo.json`)

Echo Steps, a call-and-answer dance on four humming stones (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 4.2, game 2; scripts/home/echo_steps.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. The lead hops a pattern across the stones on the beat and you answer it with W, A, S, D; in the last round you lead and the rival copies. Hits and streaks score. Solo (the stones lead) with one rested Boki out, against the next rested Boki with two. Units: beats at bpm, milliseconds for the hit window, seconds otherwise; joy and trust are 0-100 points.

Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. 2 to 4 Boki run one lap of a short loop next to the Training post; you back your partner and cheer with the training drill's timing bar at three marks. Units: metres, seconds, metres a second; joy and trust are 0-100 points, bonds -1..1.

Stump Shove, the Boki base's second minigame (briefs/design/GARDEN.md section 5.2, scripts/home/base_shove.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. Two Boki push on a stump from opposite sides until one is shoved off balance; you back your partner and press once, timed on the training drill's bar. Units: seconds, stump balance -1..1 (a side wins at its own end), joy and trust are 0-100 points.

| stats_doc | Each trained Power point adds this fraction to its push; each Guard point adds this fraction to its hold (half a percent a point, like the match bonus); 20 points are worth about the 10% type edge. A side's push against the other's hold is push / hold, so the drift is attacker over defender both ways. |

| mood_doc | Push multiplier at joy 0 and at joy 100 (linear in between). |
| trust_max | 1.05 |
| trust_doc | Push multiplier at trust 100 (linear from 1.0 at trust 0). |

## base_tumble (`content/rules/base_tumble.json`)

Tumble, a duel beside the Stump Shove's stump (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md 4.2 game 1, scripts/home/base_tumble.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. Best of five exchanges; both sides pick Rush, Brace or Dodge at once; the winner pushes the loser back along a ring three steps deep on each side. Units: seconds, steps (the ring's unit of push), metres, stat points (0-100), trust 0-100.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| moves | {"rush": {"stat": "power", "beats": "dodge", "trait": "temper", "name": "Rush", "clip": "attack"}, "brace": {"stat": "guard", "beats": "rush", "trait": "loyalty", "name": "Brace", "clip": "idle"}, "dodge": {"stat": "speed", "beats": "brace", "trait": "curiosity", "name": "Dodge", "clip": "hop"}} |
| moves_doc | Keys 1, 2, 3 in this order. Each move pushes with its stat and beats one other; 'trait' is the personality that leans a Boki toward it, 'clip' its rig clip (Brace adds the 'guard' pose). |
| exchanges | 5 |
| extra_max | 2 |
| exchanges_doc | A bout is five exchanges; a dead level after five plays up to extra_max more, then goes to whoever won more exchanges (the rival on a full tie). |
| depth | 3 |
| depth_doc | Steps from the middle to each edge of the ring: pushed this far back is out. |
| lead | 20 |
| lead_doc | A win pushes one step, two when the winner's push for its move's stat is this much over the loser's for the same stat. |
| clash_step | 0.5 |
| clash_doc | The same move on both sides: the higher push for that stat moves the other half a step (nothing on a dead level). |
| base | 10 |
| base_doc | Points of push every Boki has before its stat, so the edge, press and follow multipliers count with zero trained points. |
| edge | 1.1 |
| edge_doc | Push multiplier when a species theme beats the other's in base_shove.json 'beats' (the Shove's 10% type edge). |
| follow | 1.1 |
| follow_trust | 1 |
| follow_doc | Going with what your own Boki wants: push multiplier for that exchange and trust (points, paid when the bout is settled). Overriding it costs nothing. |
| press | {"great": 1.15, "good": 1.07, "miss": 1.0} |
| press_doc | The timed press on impact (the drill bar): push multiplier for that exchange. |
| rival_press | {"great": 0.2, "good": 0.45} |
| rival_press_doc | The rival's own impact press: chance of a great, else of a good, else a miss. |
| lean_centre | {"temper": 0.36, "loyalty": 0.72, "curiosity": 0.55} |
| lean_floor | 0.34 |
| lean_min | 0.05 |
| lean_doc | How likely a Boki is to want each move: lean_floor plus its trait minus that trait's centre, never under lean_min. The centres are set so each move is wanted a third of the time across the common species of content/kin_v2, birth noise included. |
| honest | [0.7, 0.5] |
| honest_doc | Chance the tell you see is the move the other side really plans: for the side with the higher Focus, and for the other (and on equal Focus). |
| rival_read | 0.35 |
| rival_read_doc | Chance the rival plays against what your Boki wants (as its own tell shows it) instead of its nature. |
| intro_s | 6 |
| tell_s | 1.5 |
| pick_s | 3 |
| impact_s | 2.5 |
| push_s | 6.8 |
| result_s | 5.5 |
| time_doc | Seconds: the walk to the marks before the first tell; the rival's tell; the pick window after it (no pick goes with what your Boki wants); the charge, with one press on the drill bar while it runs (none is a miss), the hit landing as it ends; the shove, slide, shake-off and walk back to the marks with the push shown; the tumble off before the card. |
| visitor_spread | 15 |
| visitor_doc | With one rested Boki, a garden visitor is the rival: a random species, each stat within this many points of yours. |

## base_volley (`content/rules/base_volley.json`)

Spark Volley, the Boki base's fourth minigame (briefs/design/GARDEN.md section 5.4, scripts/home/base_volley.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. Two Boki bat a glowing seed over a log, first to to_win points; a miss gives the other side the point. You back your partner and call one spike on the training drill's bar. Units: seconds, joy and trust are 0-100 points.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| to_win | 5 |
| base_return | 0.7 |
| base_doc | Chance a Boki returns a seed hit by an equal Boki. The real chance is base_return times its own strength over the hitter's, kept between min_return and max_return. |
| min_return | 0.25 |
| max_return | 0.92 |
| speed_per_point | 0.005 |
| focus_per_point | 0.005 |
| stats_doc | Strength = (1 + Speed points x speed_per_point) x (1 + Focus points x focus_per_point): Speed gets it under the seed, Focus reads where it goes. Half a percent a point each, like the match bonus. |
| mood | [0.92, 1.08] |
| mood_doc | Strength multiplier at joy 0 and at joy 100 (linear in between). |
| trust_max | 1.05 |
| trust_doc | Strength multiplier at trust 100 (linear from 1.0 at trust 0). |
| edge | 1.08 |
| edge_doc | Strength multiplier for a Boki whose species theme beats the other's (the 'beats' table of content/rules/base_shove.json, so there is one element table). |
| spike | {"great": 0.3, "good": 0.6, "miss": 1.0} |
| spike_doc | Your one call: the backed Boki's next hit is a spike and the other side's chance to return it is multiplied by this. |
| serve_s | 0.8 |
| fly_s | 0.75 |
| spike_fly_s | 0.4 |
| point_s | 1.1 |
| max_s | 150 |
| max_doc | A match still going at this many seconds goes to the side ahead (the server on a tie). |
| energy | 8 |
| energy_doc | Each player spends this much energy (BaseRace.entrants only picks rested Boki). |
| win_joy | 12 |
| win_trust | 3 |
| lose_joy | -8 |
| gems_win | 4 |
| gems_ran | 1 |
| gems_doc | Gems to you when your backed Boki wins, or for any other match. |
| card_s | 6 |
| courts | {"glasswater": {"at": [38.5, 31.5], "splash": "9fe4f2"}} |
| courts_doc | A zone's own court (GardenZones.here): at = the log's middle, tiles; splash = the colour of the water a miss throws up. It lies across the zone's shallow channel (garden_zones.json build.shallow) and needs no Training post. |

## boki_lines (`content/rules/boki_lines.json`)

What Boki say (BokiLines, docs/BOKI_TALK.md). tuning: max_words = the most words in one bubble (punctuation and symbols don't count); act_words = the most words in one action, which a young Boki says after its name; bubble_s = seconds a bubble stays up; cooldown_s = seconds a Boki waits between lines (a trigger marked direct answers something you did and skips the wait); no_repeat = how many of its own last lines a Boki never repeats; min_lines = the fewest general lines a trigger may have; grown_stage = the speech stage (Care.speech) from which a Boki says lines instead of its name. tones = how a young Boki says its name, by feeling ({A} first syllable, {a} lower, {b} second syllable, {F} full name, {f} lower, {U} upper; KinSpeak.fill). sounds = noises a tone may use besides the name. alias = old trigger names that share another's lines. triggers: feel (a tone), word (the one word a stage-1 Boki adds), acts (what it does), lines._ (anyone) and lines.<element> (extra lines for a Boki of that element, the species' type).

## boki_system (`content/rules/boki_system.json`)

The Boki command system (docs/decisions/0001, 0002): G sic / call back / wheel, follow, the downed Boki, the leashes. Distances in metres, times in seconds, hp as a share of max health.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| class_ults | False |
| class_ults_doc | false: the Merge key is the Merge for every class. true: it runs the class's own ultimate again (ArchKit.use_r), kept for the hero-port work to fold into kits. |
| bond_from_ult | {"hit": 0.6, "knock": 0.7, "kill": 0.8} |
| bond_from_ult_doc | Share of the bond bar a hero's own ultimate pays (KinBond.from_ult): the best event of one cast counts (a hit, a knock, a kill), never added per target. Fighting still fills the bar, so Merge is never locked behind the ult. |
| g_hold_s | 0.35 |
| throw_range | 9 |
| throw_range_dive | 11 |
| recall_range | 24 |
| merge_leap_range | 32 |
| land_stagger | {"radius": 1.7, "stun": 0.7, "kb": 3.0, "dmg_k": 0.8} |
| recall_hit | {"width": 0.9, "dmg_k": 1.0, "stun": 0.35, "kb": 5.0} |
| loss | {"desc": "Losing a Boki (docs/decisions/0008). loss_min_tier: tiers below it are safe (your Boki goes home with you when you die); from it up, a Boki drops dazed when its hunter dies, guards the spot, and can be scanned by an enemy. bond_ping_s: seconds between map pings of the hunter carrying a captured Boki. guard_r: metres from the deathbox a dropped Boki stands.", "loss_min_tier": 2, "bond_ping_s": 15.0, "guard_r": 1.4} |
| regen | {"carried_pct_s": 0.06, "out_pct_s": 0.015, "out_delay_s": 6.0, "desc": "Health a Boki wins back on its own, as a share of max health per second: on you (Return, settled) 6%/s; out beside you 1.5%/s once it has gone out_delay_s without taking damage. A downed Boki never regenerates (rescue it). Kin.regen_quiet counts the seconds since it last lost health; Blight cuts it like any healing."} |
| down | {"recover_s_trusting": 15.0, "recover_s_wary": 20.0, "recover_hp": 0.2, "rescue_hp": 0.6, "rescue_s": 3.5, "rescue_r": 1.5, "rescue_block_s": 0.6, "contest_r": 1.2, "carry_speed_k": 0.9, "carry_lift_s": 0.3, "rescue_done_s": 0.45} |
| follow | {"separation_r": 1.2, "path_every_s": 0.45, "path_goal_moved": 3, "path_fail_backoff_s": 1.5, "path_lookahead": 8, "path_window": 12, "stuck_s": 1.0, "hop_dur": 0.38, "hop_height": 1.1, "hop_on_air_s": 0.4, "hop_off_steady_s": 0.35, "away_dist": 8.0, "combat_radius": 12.0, "hesitate_s": 0.3, "sic_cd": 1.0, "sic_speed": 18.0, "engage_range": 9.0, "disengage_range": 4.0, "guard_leash": 24.0, "chase_leash": 30.0} |
| follow_doc | stuck_s: seconds without progress before the hop back. hop_on_air_s: seconds you are off the ground before it hops on (when it cannot walk where you land). hop_off_steady_s: seconds steady on the ground before it hops off again. disengage_range: m; after an explicit Follow in a fight, a foe hitting the Boki or you from this close sends it back into the fight. away_dist: farther than this and a G tap is Call back (else Sic). combat_radius: a foe this close to you or the target means a fight (orders are never refused). path_window: tiles of margin round the trip for the A* search. path_every_s: seconds between searches; path_goal_moved: tiles the goal may move before it searches early; path_fail_backoff_s: wait after a search that found nothing; path_lookahead: path tiles checked ahead for a straight line. separation_r: m it keeps from you. |
| wheel | {"deadzone_px": 30, "pop_s": 0.14, "radius_px": 92} |

## class_unlock (`content/rules/class_unlock.json`)

Hunter unlocks and mastery (docs/decisions/0005). A new save wears Vex first (`starters`, picked on the first-Relic screen, free at the first portal) and plays the tutorial as Vex. After its first finished expedition the player picks one of `second_picks` as the second Relic; the other two open through their own challenges, like Lace. Every other Hunter opens through its own challenge in `unlock`, counted across all your expeditions whoever you play; a challenge with `after` also waits until that many Hunters are open. A done challenge never opens a Hunter by itself: the player holds the button on the Hunters screen for `hold_s` seconds. `mastery` lists each Hunter's goals, counted only in expeditions played as that Hunter; each one done is a mastery level and a cosmetic reward. Rewards are cosmetic only (`reward_kinds`). Ids are Hunter ids, never display names. Every number is a placeholder until the owner tunes it.

Path meter for branching finals (scripts/core/evo_path.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 3; docs/decisions/0022). Lines are keyed by species id. Each end: form id (art at art/kin/<form>/<form>.glb, missing = the Boki waits), path (the affinity of its path tokens, garden_items.json), stat (its key stat, Care.STATS), type (its second type, lean.json), traits (any at trait_at or more gives a care pip), sports (games whose Cup Ribbons count, garden_prizes.json ids). level: the level the final is due. ## farm_build (`content/rules/farm_build.json`)

The farm building pass (docs/decisions/0004-farm-building.md). Farm level is points from play; items unlock by farm level or a milestone; new buildings are construction sites that you hammer (hold interact) and your Boki help build; the materials are spent a quarter at a time as the work goes; buildings upgrade L1 to L3. Units: gems and materials are counts, labour is work swings (one hammer beat of yours is 0.8 s, one swing of a Boki is about 3 s at building skill 1).

|---|---|
| base_mode | False |
| base_mode_doc | GARDEN.md section 8: true shrinks the farm to the Boki base. Build mode shows only Buildings, Garden and Island; no axe, pickaxe or wild chopping; no work stations, wild or haul jobs (Boki knacks still run the plot, mend and incubator chores); no Exchange, Sell tab, tools or crop-chain goods at the market; meals lean a Boki by the food's type (content/rules/lean.json, Lean) instead of the four affinities. Nothing is deleted: false changes nothing, and saves are untouched either way. |

## garden_daily (`content/rules/garden_daily.json`)

The garden's daily hooks (scripts/home/garden_wishes.gd, scripts/home/garden_away.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 5, ranks 1 and 3). Each garden day three Boki wish for something (a need back up); granting one is a gift, nothing is ever taken for missing a day. Coming back after time away brings small gifts. Nothing here lowers a need or a stat.

## garden_items (`content/rules/garden_items.json`)

Shaping items (scripts/core/garden_items.gd; design briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 1). They live in the garden bag (Save.d items), are fed from a Boki's feed menu, and always show their exact effect (no 'Effect: ?' rule). Effects: stat = +n to one Care.STATS stat up to its cap; xp = +n xp (levels and forms follow); token = a worn path token for the aff (rec.path, at most max_tokens, take_off returns it to the bag); stay = worn Stayleaf (rec.stay); rinse = clear rec.lean; loose = up to n points out of the Boki's highest stat into rec.loose; stat_all = +n to all four stats (up to the level cap); sweet = the picked type among types jumps to share of Evo.LEAN_FULL and holds (rec.hold, hold_days garden days, no fade from other meals); trait = a trait moves by (signed), counted in base_drift week_cap (rec.drift.moved); twin = shared by two Boki: trait by on each and bond between them. sources are where the item comes from; this file does not drop them. aura = a worn look, one at a time (rec.aura; its aura block is drawn by GardenAura, scripts/home/garden_aura.gd). Nest items (scripts/core/nest_items.gd) are placed in the Nesting Nook with a pair and used up when the egg is laid: nest gifts = n more inborn gifts from the parents per Thread (at most max Threads); species = the baby is the species of the parent wearing it; habit = the baby takes that parent's habit and strongest trait exactly. down = trust +trust and a memory line (one drops at every hatch).

| max_tokens_doc | Path tokens worn at once on one Boki. |

## garden_prizes (`content/rules/garden_prizes.json`)

Garden minigame prizes and weekly cups (scripts/home/garden_prizes.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 4.4). Each game has a weighted prize table (one roll for the backed Boki's win), a guaranteed first-win-of-the-day item, and a cup of three wins in a row against stronger rivals (cup.rounds). Winning the last round (Crown) gives the game's Cup Ribbon to the winning Boki (rec.ribbons) and the cup prize; one Crown per game per week per Boki. Table entries: kind item = a shaping item id in garden_items.json (banked in Save.d items), kind snack = a Data.CROPS food (banked in Save.d crops).

## garden_recipes (`content/rules/garden_recipes.json`)

## garden_seasons (`content/rules/garden_seasons.json`)

Garden seasons (scripts/home/garden_seasons.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 5 rank 9). Every few weeks one zone is in season, in list order, counted on the weekly-event clock (BaseRace.week_now, the device clock the save uses; no server). While in season: the zone's game plays its season twist (unless this week's weekly format is already for that game), the snack patch grows the season's snack on top of its four, and that game's Crown also gives the season's keepsake (rec.keepsakes, once a season per Boki).

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| weeks | 2 |
| weeks_doc | Weeks each season lasts. |

Garden XP (GARDEN_MODERN 2.5) is not built anywhere yet, so garden_xp is the brief's numbers. Everything marked assume is a sim guess, not a game rule.

## garden_trust (`content/rules/garden_trust.json`)

Trust from care at the base (Care.trust_up). Petting, its habit food and winning together each raise trust by a named amount, shown to the player as one plain line. Trust stays 0 to 100 and nothing here lowers it. A habit (rec.habit.food) is picked when a Boki hatches, from its element (the species theme).

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| pet | 1 |
| food | 2 |
| win | 3 |
| cooldown_h | 1 |
| hour_s | 12.5 |
| say | {"pet": "%s loved the scratches: trust up", "food": "%s loves %s: trust up", "win": "%s won with you: trust up"} |
| default_food | kibble |
| food_by_element | {"ember": "emberberry", "frost": "frostdrop", "bloom": "puffcorn", "storm": "tonicbrew", "stone": "pebblenut", "gravity": "ironcrisp", "titan": "scalepepper", "shadow": "duskplum", "lunar": "mindmint", "venom": "pricklepear", "echo": "chimebun", "prism": "geodecandy", "spore": "glowcap", "swarm": "sapjelly", "tempest": "tonicbrew"} |
| _units | pet, food, win: trust points (0 to 100). cooldown_h: in-game hours between two raises of one kind on one Boki. hour_s: real seconds in one in-game hour (the home day is 300 s, so 300 / 24). |

## garden_visitor (`content/rules/garden_visitor.json`)

Wild visitors (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 5 rank 6; scripts/home/garden_visitor.gd). While you are in a zone, every check_s seconds of farm time and with no visitor and none due to wait, a wild Boki may wander in: one of the common species that has a rigged model, whose theme is in the zone's group, when the zone has a toy it likes (toys.json likes) and at least residents of the group living there. It stays one garden day (care.json care_day_s), plays your games as one more Boki, and eats only what you hand it. feeds meals of its favourite make it leave an egg (or, with room in the zone, ask to stay as a new Boki). Save.d visitor = {rec, zone, t, fed, notes, next}, a lazy key with no save bump.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| check_s | 60 |

## garden_zones (`content/rules/garden_zones.json`)

The garden's hub and zones (briefs/design/GARDEN.md 10; scripts/home/garden_zones.gd, docs/decisions/0022-garden-zones.md). Save.d zones = {id: {open}}, rec zone = the Boki's home zone. zones: name, colour (its stone's glow and card), types (lean.json types; the 18 split five ways), trait (Care trait it matches), game (what its card says is played there) and wayseed_from (where the card says the Wayseed comes from). A zone with a build has its own island (scripts/home/zone_layout.gd, zone_dress.gd): theme (a HomeLayout.THEMES id), seed and sk (the fs island), deco [id, tile x, tile z, quarter turns], shallow [x0, z0, x1, z1] tiles of the channel (only Glasswater has one), clear [x0, z0, x1, z1] tiles kept free of the wild trees and rocks (they are the costliest draws; the scatter dresses the zone instead), scatter (seed, a count per kind: crystal, reed, pebble, terrace, crack; shore = tiles the crystals and reeds crowd the channel).

|---|---|
| start | bramblebank |
| start_doc | The zone open from the start and the home of every Boki in an older save. |
| wayseed_chance | 0.05 |

## glint_fishing (`content/rules/glint_fishing.json`)

Glint Fishing (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md 4.2 game 4; scripts/home/glint_fishing.gd). Solo with your partner on a rock in a zone that has a spot. Five casts: hold interact to swing the cast out and back, release on a glint, wait, press when your Boki's ears go up, then hold and release to keep the line's tension in the band until the glint is landed. Units: seconds, metres, tension 0-1, stats 0-100 points, joy and trust 0-100.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| casts | 5 |
| spots | {"glasswater": {"at": [48.5, 31.5], "toward": [-1.0, 0.0], "sign": [48.6, 33.4]}} |
| spots_doc | A zone's rock (GardenZones.here): at = where your Boki stands, tiles; toward = the cast direction over the water (garden_zones.json build.shallow); sign = the post listing what is biting today. |
| glints | 3 |
| glints_doc | Glints on the water for each cast, each with its catch rolled before you aim. |
| near_m | 1.5 |
| far_m | 7 |
| spread_m | 0.5 |
| spread_doc | A glint sits up to this far to either side of the cast line (only the distance out counts for the cast). |

| swing_doc | Seconds of holding for the cast to swing from near_m to far_m; it swings back and forth while you hold. |
| aim_m | 0.6 |
| aim_doc | A cast that lands this close to a glint takes it; further from every glint it plops into empty water and the cast is spent. |
| wait_s | [3.0, 7.0] |
| wait_doc | Seconds from the cast landing to the bite (a uniform roll). |
| warn_s | [0.3, 0.8] |

## lantern_match (`content/rules/lantern_match.json`)

Lantern Match, a memory game (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 4.2 game 6, scripts/home/lantern_match.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. Twelve glowcaps in a ring flash in pairs, then go dark; open two at a time to find the pairs. Your Boki sniffs every so often and points at the partner of the last cap you opened, if it saw that cap. Solo against the clock, or turn by turn against a Boki. Units: seconds, probabilities 0-1, joy and trust are 0-100 points.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| colours | ["#ffd166", "#7ee0ff", "#c69cff", "#8cf0a0", "#ff8fb1", "#ffa65c"] |
| colours_doc | One glow colour per pair; the ring holds two caps of each (so 12 caps). |
| flash_s | 0.6 |
| flash_doc | When a ring is dealt each pair glows for flash_s seconds in turn, then all go dark; the clock waits while it flashes. |
| time_s | 90 |
| time_doc | The clock in seconds. Versus: whoever holds more pairs when it runs out (or the ring is cleared) wins; a tie is a draw. |
| solo_goal | 18 |
| solo_doc | Solo: a cleared ring deals a fresh one (and flashes again); find solo_goal pairs before the clock runs out to win. |
| reveal_s | 0.9 |
| reveal_doc | Two caps that do not match stay lit this long, then go dark. In versus the turn then passes; a match keeps the turn. |
| sniff_s | 6 |
| sniff_per_focus | 0.02 |
| sniff_curiosity | 1 |
| sniff_doc | Seconds between your Boki's sniffs: sniff_s / ((1 + Focus points * sniff_per_focus) * (1 + (curiosity - 0.5) * sniff_curiosity)), at least sniff_min. 50 Focus sniffs twice as often; a fully curious Boki half as often again. |
| sniff_min | 1 |
| see | 0.4 |
| see_per_focus | 0.008 |
| see_doc | Chance your Boki notices a pair while it flashes: see + Focus points * see_per_focus, at most 1. Every cap opened in play it always sees. |
| foe_mem | 0.45 |
| foe_mem_per_focus | 0.008 |
| foe_mem_doc | Versus: the chance the rival Boki remembers a cap it has seen (in the flash or opened by anyone): foe_mem + its Focus points * foe_mem_per_focus, at most 0.95. |
| foe_s | 0.8 |
| foe_doc | Seconds the rival Boki takes before each cap it opens. |
| energy | 6 |
| win_joy | 10 |
| win_trust | 3 |
| lose_joy | -6 |
| gems | 4 |
| gems_doc | Gems to you when a game ends (win or not). |
| card_s | 6 |

## mantle_look (`content/rules/mantle_look.json`)

The Relic look (docs/decisions/0011-mantle-look.md). In a match a Relic wearer looks like the class's original Hunter (`wardens`: gender, folk, face, hair, palette; the class's gear and silhouette come from the archetype), nudged by the player's own person (Save look, PlayerLook). Each slider (0..1, 0.5 = neutral) moves its model factor by at most `sliders.<key>.clamp` either way (a Hunter's own `clamp` block overrides it); at home the player is their own person, with `own_k` times that range and their own colours. Each colour pick pulls the Hunter's colour `pull` of the way in HSV, never more than `hue` / `sat` / `val` (a Warden's `tint` block overrides it), so signature colours stay. Hitboxes never read any of this. `presets` set the face sliders as a starting point. Gender is the base character's (OWNER_REVIEW item 39; 'robot' builds on the male body).

Times in seconds. 'full' is the first Mask (and every first time); 'short' is a later Mask on the farm. After the first one the player can skip.

## show_ring (`content/rules/show_ring.json`)

Show Ring, a judged show on a small stage near the Training post (briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md 4.2 game 3, scripts/home/show_ring.gd). Only with farm_build.json base_mode on. Two rested Boki show: the one you back and a rival. Three rounds of up to 10 points each: Look (how it has been raised), Trick (three timed presses, the trick picked by its best stat) and Bond (it walks to you past a snack, a toy and the rival; you call as it passes each). Three judges post a taste for the week; each judge whose taste the Boki fits adds taste_bonus. Every score is worked out from the records and the presses only, so the same Boki and presses always score the same. Units: seconds, points, needs and trust 0-100, traits 0-1.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| look | {"joy": 2.0, "clean": 2.0, "lean": 2.0, "parts": 2.0, "aura": 1.0, "keepsakes": 1.0} |
| look_doc | Most points each part of Look gives (10 in all). joy and clean: in proportion to the need. lean: full points at a full lean ('in full colour'), half at half a lean or more. parts: one point a grown part level (rec.muts). aura: worn (rec.aura set). keepsakes: one point a Cup Ribbon kind held (rec.ribbons). |
| half_lean | 0.5 |
| half_lean_doc | Lean strength (Evo.lean, 0..1) that earns half the lean points. |
| tricks | {"power": {"name": "Log Lift", "line": "hoists a log three times"}, "guard": {"name": "Statue Stand", "line": "freezes in three proud poses"}, "speed": {"name": "Whirl Hop", "line": "spins through three quick hops"}, "focus": {"name": "Pebble Balance", "line": "balances three pebbles on its nose"}} |
| tricks_doc | The trick a Boki shows, by its highest trained stat (Care.STATS order on a tie). |

| press_doc | Trick points a timed press grades to; three presses, so 9 at most. |
| stat_per_point | 0.02 |
| stat_doc | Trick points a point of the trick's stat adds, up to 1 (50 points of it). |
| trick_s | 25 |
| trick_doc | Seconds for the three presses; presses not made by then are misses. |
| lures | [{"id": "snack", "name": "a snack", "at": 0.25, "pull": 0.8}, {"id": "toy", "name": "a toy", "at": 0.5, "pull": 0.7}, {"id": "rival", "name": "its rival", "at": 0.75, "pull": 0.6}] |

## snack_patch (`content/rules/snack_patch.json`)

The garden's one snack patch (scripts/home/snack_patch.gd, base_mode only; GARDEN.md section 10 question 1). It grows one of each snack in snacks every grow_secs and you pick them up by walking over it. They go to the pantry (Save.d crops) to feed the element-lean foods; the patch is never sold and has no seed, shop or water chore.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| snacks | ["emberberry", "tidebloom", "sunroot", "puffcorn"] |
| snacks_doc | Four Data.CROPS foods, one per lean element (lean.json foods): Fire, Water, Grass, Flying. Each one is yielded once per ripening. |
| zone_snacks | {"bramblebank": ["kibble", "sweetbun", "sunroot", "sapjelly", "glowcap"], "glasswater": ["tidebloom", "frostdrop", "geodecandy"], "cinderstep": ["emberberry", "pebblenut", "ironcrisp", "scalepepper"], "hushwood": ["duskplum", "mindmint", "pricklepear"], "ridge": ["puffcorn", "tonicbrew", "starfruit", "chimebun"]} |
| zone_snacks_doc | Each zone's snack list, the foods of its group's types (GARDEN.md 10.2): Bramblebank normal, grass, bug, spore; Glasswater water, ice, crystal; Cinderstep fire, rock, steel, dragon; Hushwood dark, psychic, poison; Kitewind (theme ridge) flying, electric, fairy, sound. Every food in lean.json is in exactly one list (--lean-snacks-check). A patch on a theme with a list grows that list; the key is the home_layout THEMES id. |
| grow_secs | 480 |
| grow_secs_doc | Seconds from put down (or from the last pick) until it is ripe; it keeps ripening while you are away, but only one batch waits at a time. |
| reach | 0.35 |
| reach_doc | Tiles beyond the patch's edge from which your feet pick the snacks. |
| rotate_doc | Until the zones are built (only ridge is), the start garden's patch grows its four snacks and one more every ripening: the next food, in the order of the zone lists, that is not one of its four. rot on the patch's deco entry counts the ripenings. |

## unstable_mix (`content/rules/unstable_mix.json`)

When two Boki are paired in the Nesting Nook the pair is an unstable mix if their elements clash (a pair in clashes) or their tempers oppose (bravery or temper at least trait_gap apart, 0 to 1). The baby then hatches with joy at hatch_joy (0 to 100) and the 'Needs extra care' tag, which clears after care_s seconds spent doing at least fine_condition (0 to 100 Care.condition). A story, never a loss. types maps each game type id to its standard name (GAME_RULES_NOV8, 18 types).

| Setting | Value |

| hatch_joy | 35 |
| care_s | 86400 |
| fine_condition | 50 |
| trait_gap | 0.5 |

## wade (`content/rules/wade.json`)

Boki wading (GARDEN.md section 4, scripts/home/boki_wade.gd; only while farm_build.json base_mode is on). A Boki in pond or stream water walks at wade_speed (shallow edge) or deep_speed (the middle) of its dry speed, leaves a ripple every ripple_secs and a splash going in, and shakes off coming out. Water, Ice and Crystal leans paddle: with linger_chance a free roaming one stays linger_secs in the water playing (the splash clip) and gains joy_per_sec. Fire leans hurry out: at out_speed to the nearest dry ground, which takes under 2 s. Everyone else wades through. Units: multipliers of walk speed, seconds, joy points a second.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| wade_speed | 0.6 |
| deep_speed | 0.45 |
| ripple_secs | 0.6 |
| shake_secs | 0.6 |
| paddle | ["water", "ice", "prism", "frost", "crystal"] |
| paddle_doc | Lean or species-theme keys (HomeToys.lean_of) that paddle: the Water, Ice and Crystal types (themes prism and frost today). |
| fire | ["fire", "ember"] |
| fire_doc | Lean or species-theme keys that step out fast: the Fire type (theme ember today). |
| out_speed | 1.5 |
| out_reach | 8 |
| out_reach_doc | m: how far a Fire Boki looks for dry ground to step out to. |
| linger_chance | 0.6 |
| linger_secs | [4.0, 8.0] |
| joy_per_sec | 0.8 |

## warden_look (`content/rules/warden_look.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | A Warden 3D model's own shading over the shared painted look (WardenGlb.look), keyed by the model's art name (art/wardens/<art>/<art>.glb; a design variant has its own key). painted: hero_toon.gdshader parameters on all of its surfaces, set after WardenGlb.PAINTED. slots: the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, eyes, glow), after painted. Colours are [r, g, b]. A model without an entry keeps the shared look. Useful keys: rim_far and rim_far_color (a rim in the Hunter's signature colour at the match camera), top_light (surfaces facing up lift), fres and fres_tint (the coloured rim; 1 = lightened own colour), far_lift (brighter and richer at the match camera), shade and shadow_tint (the shadow floor and its tint), sheen, glow (emission x the painted colour), light_neutral_warm (takes the hue out of warm lights too: black cloth and gunmetal stay black and grey under an orange sun). halos: glow discs of a constant size on screen on the model's anchors (a lens a pixel wide at the match camera): anchor, color, strength, px (radius on screen), near and far (m: none this close, full from there; close-ups keep the lens itself). albedo: a colour multiplier on the slot's atlas, applied on top of the player's colour pick (it never replaces the pick). Match zoom (the shared far_* look, WardenGlb.PAINTED; set these per model only to tune it): far_fres (the pale fresnel's share left at the match camera, 0.35), far_spec (gloss, sheen and the lights' rims there, 0), far_clamp (stray texels pulled to their coarser mip, 0.8), far_rim_soft (1: rim_far is a broad saturated band in rim_far_color; keep rim_far 0.25-0.35), far_glow (whatever glows a step brighter there, 0.6). no_ink: material tags or slots drawn without the ink shell (e.g. ["gum", "crossbow"]). ink: the model's own ink shell, far_thin (0.8), far_cut (0.55: gone from ~13.5 m; 0 keeps it), color. glow_shell: the glow slot's halo at the match camera (glow_px 1.4 screen px, glow_k 1.3, glow_near 7, glow_far 14 m, glow_col; {"glow_px": 0} for none). A card slot's far keys (shaders/warden_card.gdshader, under slots.card): far_sheen 0, far_edge 1, far_alpha 1.35. the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, brass, eyes, glow), after painted; a "<slot>-<tag>" key (hair-braid: the woven braids) after its slot. paint_glow, paint_glow_color and paint_glow_width: texels of that painted colour glow (a skin's tattoos at night). weapon_scale: a size multiplier on the held .glb weapon; weapon_offset: [x, y, z] metres that move it in the Gun's space (seats the grip in the hand: Lace's bow). |

## warden_stance (`content/rules/warden_stance.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Each Warden's signature stance on the shared rig (scripts/match/warden_stance.gd), keyed by archetype id. gait: how the body stands and moves over its class (HunterAnim.STANCE keys: knee, width, lean, bounce, arm, elbow, cadence, stride, fidgets). pose: offsets on the rig's bones, full in idle and blended into run, aim and abilities at the blend weights below. spine: forward lean (rad, + forward). tilt: the shoulders drop toward the weight leg (rad). twist: the shoulders turn (rad, + left). hip: the hips shift over the weight leg (m). lift: the body up (m, + up). back: the hips back (m). knee: extra bend in both knees (rad). spread: the legs wider apart (rad). free_leg: the free leg's hip (+ forward) and knee bend (rad). head: pitch (+ chin up), yaw (+ left), roll (+ toward the left shoulder) (rad). arm_l: the free left hand's place from its rest (m, model space: x right, y up, z back). carry: the weapon's idle place under Aim, pos (m) and rot (pitch, yaw, roll, rad), free_l 1 to let the left hand off it (free_r 1: the right, for a weapon carried in the left hand); it blends to the aim pose the moment the Hunter fires. leg: the weight leg (l or r). idle: breath (rate, rad/s), breath_amp (x the breathing), shift (s on the weight leg before a short shift to the other), fidget (every and dur in s; body, head, hip and gun offsets at the fidget's peak, wave times over). |

## weapon_path (`content/rules/weapon_path.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | The fixed weapon path (scripts/match/weapon_path.gd): on every even level (2, 4, 6, 8, 10) a hunter's signature weapon takes the next step on its hero's path, with no choice to make. Each step is a plain weapon upgrade id from Data.PERKS (WeaponUps: hotload = damage, deepmag = magazine (only Vex: no other hero weapon has ammo), quickfeed = fire rate, longreach = range). One entry per hero in Arch.ORDER. Brands are not on the path: they come from perk orbs. If an orb already maxed a step, the next open plain upgrade is taken instead. default is for a hunter with no hero. |
| default | ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"] |
| paths | {"thief": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "archer": ["hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach"], "mage": ["hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload"], "gunslinger": ["quickfeed", "hotload", "deepmag", "hotload", "longreach"], "juggernaut": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload"], "bulwark": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "dredge": ["hotload", "hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach"], "ashwick": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "tender": ["quickfeed", "hotload", "hotload", "longreach", "hotload"], "rimewright": ["hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach"], "dolm": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed"], "ostra": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload"]} |

## wisp_looks (`content/rules/wisp_looks.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | Wisp looks (docs/decisions/0019-downed-wisp.md): what a downed Hunter turns into. Add a look = add an entry under 'looks'; any key left out comes from 'default'. A look is chosen by its id in Save.d['look']['wisp']. Colours: 'team' (the hunter's side colour, SideColor: you, ally, foe) or a hex string. Times in seconds, sizes in metres, sfx names from Sfx.NAMES. |
| default | default |
| looks | {"default": {"name": "Wisp", "desc": "A small glowing spirit in your team's colour.", "core": {"radius": 0.34, "color": "team", "rim": "ffffff", "glow": 0.45, "flicker": 0.25, "flicker_hz": 9.0}, "halo": {"radius": 0.8, "alpha": 0.5}, "eyes": {"on": true, "color": "1a1530", "size": 0.055, "gap": 0.1, "height": 0.04}, "motes": {"amount": 10, "color": "ffffff", "size": 0.05, "life": 0.9, "rise": 0.5}, "trail": {"amount": 20, "color": "team", "size": 0.16, "life": 0.5}, "hover": 1.0, "bob": 0.12, "bob_hz": 1.1, "lean": 0.5, "stretch": 0.18, "pop_in": {"time": 0.25, "ring": 1.4, "burst": 14, "sfx": "scan_pop"}, "pop_out": {"time": 0.3, "ring": 1.8, "burst": 18, "sfx": "revive", "hero_from": 0.6, "squash": 0.25}, "snuff": {"burst": 24, "sfx": "hit"}}} |

## Combos

One fighter sets a foe up with a status, the partner pays it off (`content/combos/`).

| Combo | Shows | Set up by | With | Paid off by | Window | Bonus | Bond |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Combo | COMBO | your Boki | stun, root | you | 2.5s | +35% | +5% of a meter |
| Kindling | FLARE | anyone | burn | your Boki's ability | 3s | +25% | +3% of a meter |
| Pounce | POUNCE | you | stun, slow | your Boki | 2.5s | +60% | +4% of a meter |
